response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (~18 years) with strong full-stack, cloud, and production-systems credentials, and his current role includes relevant MCP and agentic-workflow tooling. However, his hands-on GenAI experience appears limited to roughly the past year, falling well short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, and there is no demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, evaluation pipelines, or Python. He could be worth a conversation if the AI experience bar is flexible, but on paper he does not meet the core requirements for this staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Deep, broad software engineering experience across web, backend, and high-throughput distributed systems
Current hands-on work with MCP code generators and AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq
Proven mentorship and technical-community leadership (workshops, courses, open-source projects)
concerns: Far short of the required 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions (~1 year of AI-adjacent work)
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience
Python not listed among skills, and limited evidence of customer-facing technical discovery leadership

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and production-systems background
Recent MCP and agentic-workflow tooling exposure
